findings.resolvedReason: Removed the dead void stories EffStory fixture from the smoke (commit 93cdef4d1).

findings.desc: type-safety / misleading-field: core/experience-effectiveness.ts:231 `precision: ratio(preWarnable, preWarnable)` always evaluates to 1 or 0 by construction (ratio of a number with itself). The PredictiveValueReport interface exposes `precision` as a meaningful metric, but it carries no information beyond `preWarnable > 0`. JSON consumers reading the output would be misled into treating it as a genuine IR precision score. The field should either be removed from the interface or its degenerate-constant nature must be made explicit in the interface name/type (e.g., rename to `precisionNote` with a string, or remove and keep only `recall`).
findings.resolvedReason: Removed the vacuous precision field (ratio(preWarnable,preWarnable) always 0/1, no information) from PredictiveValueReport + computation + render + json + smoke; kept recall + windowed trend (commit 93cdef4d1).

findings.desc: CHK-002:happy:1 and CHK-002:happy:2 lack literal CLI flag coverage: intent requires exercising `lattice learning_effectiveness --json` (verify JSON output shape) and `lattice learning_effectiveness --confirmedOnly` (verify CLI flag threads to leaf), but the bound evidence command `npm --prefix packages/main run test:experience-layer-effectiveness` only invokes the bare CLI once (no --json, no --confirmedOnly) and tests confirmedOnly only at the direct JS function call level. These are distinct code paths (CLI argument parsing to leaf option) with no exercised test.

CHK-002:edge:0-3 (empty store, no findings, no arm events, --json+--confirmedOnly combined) bound to `npm --prefix packages/main run test:experience-layer-effectiveness` but the smoke contains no CLI invocation against an empty or edge-shaped store. The smoke exercises leaf-level empty input (computePredictiveValue([])) which is correct for CHK-001 edge intents, but CHK-002 edge intents explicitly describe running the `lattice learning_effectiveness` command on a store with those characteristics. No CLI call with an empty/fixture store exists in either the smoke or the verifier.
